messages.subject: Error with "count" output
parts:
Hi,
I"m trying to write a count detection history to later use as an index covariate. I have run the code succesfully to make a binary detection history with no problem. The only thing I change is output=c("binary") to output=c("count") with all the rest of the code identical. I end up with an error saying

 "Error in record.hist[match(names(occasions.by.station)[xyz], rownames(record.hist)),  : 
  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length"

The camOp file, input file, and everything is the same but I keep getting this error and it prevents a detection history from being produced. 

Here's the rest of the code in case it helps
detectionHistory(recordTable = CL, species = "clouded leopard", 
                 camOp = camOp, output = c("count"), stationCol = "station",
                 speciesCol ="species", recordDateTimeCol ="vid_date",
                 recordDateTimeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d", occasionLength = 30, 
                 day1 = "2015-07-01", includeEffort = TRUE, scaleEffort = FALSE,
                 occasionStartTime = 0,datesAsOccasionNames = TRUE,  timeZone ="Pacific/Johnston",
                 writecsv = TRUE, outDir =("C:/Users/selwynra/Desktop/analysis/output/30 day"),
                 unmarkedMultFrameInput = FALSE)

Does anyone have any idea what might be causing this? 

cheers, 
-Rachel

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error with "count" output
parts:
Hi, 
thank you for the data. The problem was that in your example the record date/time was defined as date only:

recordDateTimeCol ="vid_date",
recordDateTimeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d"

At one station there was a record on the day the first station was set up. The time difference of that record relative to the camera setup was thus calculated as 0, which made camtrapR try to assign that record to column 0 in the detection matrix. And of course there is not column 0.

The fix was to combine record date and time, which leads to time differences greater than 0.

rec$DateTime <- paste(rec$vid_date, rec$vid_time)

and use that in 

detectionHistory(..., recordDateTimeCol = "DateTime",
                      recordDateTimeFormat = "dmy HMS")

Interesting issue. I will change the package accordingly and at least give users a warning in the future.
Thank you for bringing it up. 
Best regards,
Jürgen
